name: ninja-testing
description: Testing harness distilled from the JavaScript Ninja testing course: an interview-driven generator (/ninja-testing:init) that writes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, hooks and a test-reviewer subagent tailored to your repo, plus /ninja-testing:review and /ninja-testing:mode, and eight procedures the agent applies on its own (test-as-spec, test-plan-by-level, mutation-loop, legacy-characterize, integration-boundaries, external-contract, e2e-select, flaky-triage).
